DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn first, an account of what it was based on, and nothing on Owen's record.
What moved her: Nothing did, because the offer of a rewrite came with no document or detail behind the zero, so she had no reason to give up any ground.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite twice before answering her question about how the zero was decided, which made the offer sound like a way to avoid the question.
Try next time: Right after her opening question, say in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then say plainly what you actually have, and only then bring up a rewrite.
